title: Nike Profit Detective
why: Nike went through several quarters of falling profit in 2024 and 2025 while individual functions could still point to their own targets being met. This tool joins Marketing, HR, Operations and Finance data to find the cross-team chain behind the decline.
problem: Company profitability has declined for three consecutive quarters, but individual departments report satisfactory performance. Develop an AI business analyst that integrates Marketing, HR, Operations and Finance data to identify cross-functional relationships responsible for the decline.
data_note: 36 months of Marketing, HR, Operations and Finance data for one geography (sample data, $ millions).

steps.detail: Marketing, HR, Operations and Finance, monthly
Each team against its own target
Latest quarter vs a year ago: volume, price, cost, opex
Cross-correlations between team metrics at 0 to 3 month lags
Keep strong, directional links as a cause chain
Regression of operating margin on cross-team metrics
Where one team's win is another team's cost
Simulate coordinated fixes and explain them

questions: Why is profit falling if every team hit target?
What if we stop discounting but sales drop?
Write the board memo on this
author: K Mohan Kumar
